@graph.headline: Why Spring Is the Smartest Time to Install Your Fence in Oakland County
@graph.description: Learn why spring is the best season for fence installation in Oakland County, Michigan. Expert advice on timing, costs, wood selection, and what to expect from a professional installation.

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to install a fence in Michigan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Spring (mid-April through May) is the best time for fence installation in Michigan. The ground has thawed, the weather is mild, and contractors have more availability than during the summer rush. This timing also gives your fence months to settle before facing its first Michigan winter.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a fence?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard residential fence (150 linear feet) takes one to three days for a professional crew to install. Larger projects, difficult terrain, or custom gate work may extend the timeline to four or five days.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to install a fence in Oakland County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most municipalities in Oakland County require a fence permit. Requirements vary by city, so check with your local building department. BF Fence handles the permit process for you as part of every installation.

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my fence after winter damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: If only a few boards are loose or a single post is leaning, repair is usually the right call. But if multiple posts are leaning, there's widespread rot, or your fence is over 15 years old, replacement is typically more cost-effective in the long run.
